declarations.name: dirichletXi
declarations.doc: The `N^{s/2}`-renormalized completed Dirichlet L-function: with this normalization the functional equation has a CONSTANT root number.

declarations.name: dirichletXi_one_sub
declarations.doc: Constant-ε functional equation** for the renormalized completed L-function of a primitive character: `dirichletXi χ (1−s) = rootNumber χ · dirichletXi χ⁻¹ s`.

declarations.name: ewqCompletedLFunction_one_sub_meyer
declarations.doc: The ordinary completed L-function transforms by the inverse composite Meyer character. The conductor half-density above is exactly what cancels this multiplier in `dirichletXi`.
